ImageDescription.value:
A bit of old carpet, salvaged from trash when the Saenger Theater, New Orleans, was being renovated after Hurricane Katrina.

The friend who salvaged it says that the reds were more vibrant, but faded when the very dirty piece of carpet was cleaned. They believe it is original from the 1920s.
